# A523 (Trimui Smart Pro S) — STOCK display register full dump
#
# SoC: Allwinner A523 / sun55iw3p1.  Panel DDIC: er68576 (720x1280 MIPI-DSI).
# Captured 2026-10-22 from the **vendor firmware v1.0.2** (Longan, kernel 5.15.147)
# booted from eMMC, with the display WORKING, via:  adb shell + busybox `devmem`
# reading /dev/mem.  Only blocks the live vendor display keeps clocked are read
# (reading gated MMIO can hard-freeze the SoC); the optional DE enhancement blocks
# (gamma/DLC/CM/deband/dither) are intentionally NOT read.
#
# Format: "0xPHYSADDR = 0xVALUE" (32-bit).  Device serial redacted.
#
# ── KEY FINDINGS (why this matters for the mainline port) ─────────────────────
#  * ACTIVE overlay channel = phys chn 0 / VI0 (0x5101000 ATTCTL=0xFF008003);
#    phys chn 1..6 all read ATTCTL=0 — the vendor composites the primary plane in
#    a VIDEO channel, not a UI channel.
#  * VSU scaler DISABLED: phy0 VSU 0x5104000 CTL=0 (coeff SRAM holds stale values).
#  * Framebuffer is LANDSCAPE: phy0 pitch 0x510100c=0x1400 (=5120=1280*4).
#  * Layer/blender/TCON active size all = 0x02CF04FF (720x1280 in DE field order).
#  * Routing: de2tcon 0x5008010=0x32F1 (disp0->tcon1); chn2core 0x5008024=0;
#    port2chn 0x5008028=0xA9810; blender ROUTE 0x5281080=0x00FFFFF0 (pipe0->chn0);
#    mixer-GLB 0x5100000=0 (RT control lives in the DE-top RTMX 0x5008100 block).
#  * DE-top RTMX disp0: 0x5008100=1 (en), 0x5008108=0x02CF04FF (out size),
#    0x500810c=1 (auto-clk); 0x5008114/0x500811c are RCQ head pointers (not config).
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#
